extraction: Awesome LLM Agent Orchestration 2026 benchmarks and evaluations. MCP-Bench (ICLR 2026): MCP-server benchmark for tool-using agents. SwarmBench (EMNLP 2026 Findings): evaluation suite for dynamically orchestrated agent swarms. Budget-Aware Tool Use (COLM 2026): budget-aware planning and verification for tool-augmented agents. Learning What to Retain (EMNLP 2026): gated-memory routing for efficient multi-agent collaboration. EvoRoute (ACL 2026): experience-driven self-routing for cost-latency-quality tradeoffs. ACE-Router (ACL 2026): history-aware routing from MCP tools to open Agent Web. ProgRouter (EMNLP 2026 Findings). MAS-Orchestra (ICML 2026): holistic multi-agent orchestration as function-calling RL. Conductor (ICLR 2026): RL-trained natural-language conductor for topology and prompt orchestration. Survey: The Orchestration of Multi-Agent Systems (arXiv 2026).
